card.name: Needle gauge and bore size wording
card.fires_on: The spot just before the word gauge or bore in needle, catheter or tube descriptions, such as 'large-' before 'gauge', or a gauge number like 26 before 'gauge'.

modes.label: Large-gauge/bore hyphen
modes.description: The hyphen or 'g'/'b' piece after 'large' that leads into gauge or bore.

modes.label: Gauge number
modes.description: The last digit of a needle size number just before the word gauge.
modes.example: Infusion set with a needle of 2<<6>> gauge or larger should be used.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward continuing with 'gauge' (or 'cal'-like pieces) as the next text.
card.plain: It marks the point in a needle or tube description where the word gauge is about to come next.
